requirement.title: Restrict access to cardholder-adjacent records by business need to know

applicability.rationale: ForgeWire's payment-adjacent dispatch surface handles access-controlled records for this profile.

responsibility.description: ForgeWire operates and reviews the access-control boundary.
Underlying identity provider issues access tokens.

third_party_dependencies.name: forgewire-identity-provider
third_party_dependencies.description: Issues and revokes access tokens for the dispatch surface. Naming this dependency does not imply it is itself compliant.

gaps.description: Automated quarterly access recertification is planned but not yet implemented.

documentation_refs.description: The summary documents the evidence this mapping already references.

notes: Demonstrates assurance-mapping capability for a ForgeWire-shaped adopter profile (ACM-007). This is an example of expressiveness, not a certification: it does not assert that ForgeWire is compliant with any named framework. The kernel code path processing this record is identical, unmodified, to the one processing the adopter-neutral 'example-framework' fixture.
